name: smwmusic-professor-layton-and-the-miracle-mask-norwell
title: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask - Norwell
description:
A sad, mystical and mysterious song that first plays when you reach the ancient Norwell Wall. Makes extensive usage of ARAM, so some SMW samples have been disabled for it. I've included a more compatible version for convenience.

Samples omitted: 09 SMW @7.brr, 0D SMW @14.brr, 0F SMW @21.brr, 11 SMW @17.brr, (13 SMW Thunder.brr)*.
INCOMPATIBLE WITH: Bonus End music, (Blargg roar SFX, Thunder SFX, Valley of Bowser appears SFX, Castle destruction bomb SFX)*.
*Items in parenthesis are not a concern in the more compatible version.

versions.title: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask - Norwell
